instruction: A clean studio photograph captured in a high-angle full shot. In a minimalist white studio with a seamless white floor, the woman in the black outfit (R1) is positioned in the foreground with her back to the camera, moving forward in a dynamic stance. In the background, the woman in the white outfit (R2) faces forward and slightly left, extending her arms outward toward the other dancer. Both barefoot performers are captured mid-movement in a fluid contemporary dance sequence. Bright, diffused studio lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft, distinct shadows on the white floor.
